name: ANSI/IEEE illuminated normally-closed pushbutton symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for illuminated normally-closed pushbutton, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The illuminated NC pushbutton form retains a normally-closed contact reference while adding a separate visual indication function. Circuit interpretation must establish both the switched control path and the condition energising the lamp.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: A lit actuator does not prove that its contact is open or closed.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: Contact state and lamp state are two separately documented properties of the same assembly.
